# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph Refuses to Kiss Aseneth

---

**4:1** And Aseneth came down from her upper chamber and stood before her father and mother. And when her father and mother saw her, they were amazed at her beauty and rejoiced greatly.

**4:2** And Pentephres said to Joseph: "Behold, this is our daughter Aseneth, whom I mentioned to you. Come near and greet her, for she is your sister." And Joseph looked at Aseneth and was deeply moved.

**4:3** And Pentephres said to Aseneth: "Go near to your brother Joseph and kiss him." And she went near to Joseph to kiss him.

**4:4** But Joseph stretched-out his right hand and placed it upon her chest, and said: "It is not fitting for a man who worships God, who blesses with his mouth the living God and eats the blessed bread of life and drinks the blessed cup of immortality and is anointed with the blessed ointment of incorruption, to kiss a foreign woman who blesses with her mouth dead and dumb idols and eats from their table the bread of strangulation and drinks from their libation the cup of treachery and is anointed with the ointment of perdition."

**4:5** "But a man who worships God will kiss his mother, and the sister born of his mother, and the sister of his family and tribe, and the wife who shares his bed, who also bless with their mouth the living God."

**4:6** "Likewise it is not fitting for a woman who worships God to kiss a foreign man, for this is an abomination before the Lord God."

**4:7** And Aseneth was deeply grieved at the words of Joseph and was hurt, and she fixed her gaze upon him, her eyes filled with tears.

**4:8** And Joseph saw her and was moved with compassion toward her — for Joseph was gentle and merciful and feared the Lord — and he lifted his right hand and placed it upon her head.

**4:9** And Joseph said: "Lord God of my father Israel, the Most High, the Mighty One, who made-alive all things and called-forth from the darkness into the light and from error into truth and from death into life — you yourself, Lord, bless this virgin and renew her by your spirit, and form her anew by your hidden hand, and make her alive again by your life."

**4:10** "And let her eat the bread of your life and drink the cup of your blessing and be numbered among your people whom you have chosen before all things came-into-being."

**4:11** And when Joseph finished his prayer, Aseneth was glad and ran into her upper chamber and threw herself on her bed, because she was worn-out with joy and grief and fear and trembling and weeping.

**4:12** And when the dinner was over, Joseph said to Pentephres: "I am departing early in the morning, on my journey." And Pentephres said: "Stay with us today and depart tomorrow." But Joseph would not stay, for he said: "I must go today, for this is the day that God began to prosper my way. But if it is God's will, I will return to you on the return journey, and I will stay with you."

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
